description.cs:
English:
Web Time Reminder is a simple extension that helps you keep track of the time you spend on selected websites.
You choose which websites you want to monitor. For each website, you can configure a time limit, a timeout for automatically resetting the counter, and an interval for repeated warnings.
The extension counts only the time when the website is actually being used in the active tab. Once the configured limit is exceeded, a warning is displayed. When you close the website, the timeout countdown begins. If you reopen the website before the timeout expires, the existing time counter continues. If the website remains closed for the entire timeout period, the counter is automatically reset.
Web Time Reminder can be useful for limiting time spent on social networks, news websites, discussion forums, or any other websites where you want to better control your browsing time.
All settings and usage data are stored locally in Firefox. The extension does not transmit data to external servers or share data with third parties.
The interface is available in Czech and English. The language is automatically selected according to the Firefox language and can also be changed manually.

Česky:
Web Time Reminder je jednoduché rozšíření, které pomáhá hlídat čas strávený na vybraných webových stránkách.
Sami si určíte, které weby chcete sledovat. Pro každý web můžete nastavit časový limit, timeout pro automatické vynulování počítadla a interval opakovaného upozornění.
Rozšíření počítá pouze dobu, kdy danou stránku skutečně používáte v aktivní záložce. Po překročení nastaveného limitu zobrazí upozornění. Pokud stránku zavřete, začne běžet nastavený timeout. Jestliže ji během této doby znovu otevřete, pokračuje původní počítadlo. Pokud zůstane zavřená po celý timeout, počítadlo se automaticky vynuluje.
Web Time Reminder je vhodný například pro omezení času stráveného na sociálních sítích, zpravodajských serverech, diskusních fórech nebo jiných stránkách, na kterých nechcete trávit příliš mnoho času.
Veškeré nastavení a údaje o využití jsou uloženy pouze lokálně ve Firefoxu. Rozšíření žádná data neodesílá na externí servery ani je nesdílí s třetími stranami.
Rozhraní je dostupné v češtině a angličtině. Jazyk se automaticky zvolí podle jazyka Firefoxu a lze jej ručně přepnout.

summary.cs: Track time spent on selected websites and show recurring reminders after your configured limit.

description.en-GB: Reddit only lets you mute communities one at a time. Feed Curator for Reddit lets you hide whole kinds of communities from Popular, All or your Home feed at once, and add your own rules. Ready-made categories (all off until you switch them on): - Celebrity gossip - Reality TV - Snark communities - Streamers & influencer drama - US politics - Political headlines (by title keyword, in any subreddit) - Rage bait & freakouts - Tumblr - Webcomics - India-specific communities (plus an optional name-pattern variant) Make your own categories from any mix of: - exact subreddits (r/example) - name patterns (snark, India*) - whole-word title keywords ("comic strip") - exclusions, plus a global "always show" allowlist One-click blocking: hover any post and click the small ⊘ button to hide that community, add it to a category, add a title keyword, or always show it. It takes effect instantly and can be undone. Also included: - Choose where it filters: Popular only, Popular and All, the Home feed, or every feed. Visiting a community directly is never filtered. - Dim mode shows matched posts faded, labelled with the rule that caught them. It's handy for checking your rules. - Popup with per-category toggles, a pause button and counts of hidden posts. - A rule tester, searchable rule lists, and JSON import/export. - Works on the current Reddit site and on old.reddit.com. Privacy: everything runs locally. There's no account, no Reddit API, no analytics and no network requests. Your rules are stored only in your browser. The add-on never changes your Reddit account or its settings. Free and open source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/deanyo/Curddit Not affiliated with or endorsed by Reddit, Inc.

description.de:
Lesefluss scrolls long web pages at your reading pace. Click the toolbar icon to start and click again to pause. Your reading page stays free of control overlays.
  • Speed from 1 to 500 pixels per second, scrolling up or down.
  • Adjust your position with the mouse wheel without pausing automatic scrolling.
  • Right-click the toolbar icon to set speed, reverse direction or open settings.
  • Compact speed window with direct entry, plus/minus controls and a slider. OK/Enter applies; Escape cancels.
  • Custom single-key shortcuts such as Home, End, arrows and letters without Ctrl or Alt. They do not trigger while typing in text fields. Escape pauses on the reading page.
  • Stop at the page edge, reverse direction or wait for more content, with an adjustable delay.
  • Optional scrolling after navigation, automatic start and background scrolling.
  • Per-website settings and defaults; light and dark appearance.
Single-key shortcuts, automatic start and continued scrolling after navigation need optional website access. Firefox asks when you save those settings. Normal Play/Pause works after clicking the toolbar icon. No advertising, telemetry or transmission of page content. Settings stay local. This edition has an English interface. For Firefox Desktop 142 and later. Protected Firefox pages, the add-ons store, the internal PDF viewer and cross-origin embedded frames are not supported. Firefox may slow down or suspend background tabs. Enable only one language edition at a time.

summary.de: Auto-scroll at your own pace: Play/Pause, single-key shortcuts such as Home, a compact speed window and locally saved website settings.

  • Tempo von 1 bis 500 Pixeln pro Sekunde, aufwärts oder abwärts.

  • Rechtsklick auf das Symbol: Tempo einstellen, Richtung wechseln oder Einstellungen öffnen.
  • Kleines Tempofenster mit direkter Eingabe, Plus/Minus und Schieberegler. OK/Enter übernimmt, Escape verwirft.

  • Am Seitenende stoppen, die Richtung wechseln oder auf neue Inhalte warten, mit einstellbarer Verzögerung.
  • Optional nach Seitenwechsel weiterlesen, automatisch starten oder im Hintergrund scrollen.

Einzeltasten sowie automatisches Starten oder Fortsetzen benötigen optionalen Website-Zugriff. Firefox fragt beim Speichern danach. Normales Play/Pause funktioniert nach einem Klick auf das Symbol. Keine Werbung, keine Telemetrie und keine Übertragung von Seiteninhalten. Einstellungen bleiben lokal. Diese Ausgabe hat eine deutsche Oberfläche. Für Firefox Desktop ab Version 142. Geschützte Firefox-Seiten, der Add-ons-Store, der interne PDF-Betrachter und fremde eingebettete Frames werden nicht unterstützt. Firefox kann Hintergrundtabs verlangsamen oder anhalten. Bitte nur eine Sprachversion gleichzeitig aktivieren.

summary.de: Automatisch scrollen und entspannt lesen: Play/Pause, frei belegbare Tasten wie Home, ein kompaktes Tempofenster und lokale Website-Einstellungen.

description.en-US:
Stop online scams before they reach you. Phishing logins, fake shops, malicious ads and malware sites all rely on one thing: you clicking before you can tell. SafeHop checks every link as you browse and stops dangerous pages before they load, then explains why in plain words. Scams SafeHop stops
  • Phishing: fake bank, PayPal, Microsoft and delivery-company login pages
  • Fake online shops: copied brand names, "outlet" and "clearance" stores on brand-new domains
  • Malicious and cloaked ads: ads that show a trusted website but send you somewhere else
  • Malware sites: pages pushing infected downloads and fake updates
  • Crypto scams: fake exchanges and wallet pages
  • Fake prizes and alerts: "you've won", "claim your refund", "account suspended"
How it decides
  • Follows every redirect, including hops too fast to see, and reads destinations hidden inside links
  • Spots trusted websites being misused to forward you somewhere else
  • Catches brand names on the wrong website and lookalike spellings (micros0ft, paypa1)
  • Checks about 400,000 known malware and phishing sites (URLhaus, OpenPhish, Phishing.Database), updated through the day
  • Warns about domains registered days ago or suspended by their registrar
  • Learns from users: report a scam in one click; once confirmed, everyone is protected within the hour
Clear answers
  • Looks safe: nothing happens, browse as usual
  • Suspicious: a small banner lists the warning signs so you can decide
  • Dangerous: the page is stopped before it loads
Check a link before you click Got a link in a message or email? Paste it into the SafeHop popup to see where it really goes, how old the site is and whether it's on a scam list, without opening it. Private by design
  • Most checks run entirely inside your browser
  • For unfamiliar sites, only the site name is checked with our server, never the full address, what you type, or page content
  • Well-known sites and private network names are never sent
  • Checked site names are not stored. No accounts, no ads, no data selling
  • Cloud checks can be switched off at any time
Free. Privacy policy: https://safehop.app/privacy.html

developer_comments.en-US: Questions or false alarms? Email support@safehop.app. To report a scam site, use the "Report this scam" button on SafeHop's block page.

description.vi: Sablekiln is a miniature ceramic-workshop puzzle played in the Firefox popup. Build a line on a fixed eight-by-five workbench by placing heater, blue-glaze, amber-glaze, cooler, and turning stations. Every station has an exit arrow that can steer the vessel; empty tiles carry it straight. Heaters add heat directly and warm adjacent tiles, while coolers remove heat. Glaze only adheres within a safe temperature window. Firing blue before amber produces opal; reversing the order muddies the glaze. Each of three contracts requires a particular glaze and final dispatch temperature. Later workbenches add walls that force planned detours and careful use of limited stations. STEP advances one beat for inspection; RUN transports automatically. A failed vessel can be reset without removing the layout. Layout, vessel state, contract progress, and the completed workshop are saved locally.

summary.vi: Build a compact ceramic production line and fire three exacting contracts.

description.vi: Hollowcue Theatre is a three-act causal-deduction game contained in the Firefox popup. Each act begins with a puzzling stage event. Run its original scene, change exactly one light, sound, or prop cue, and replay to isolate what changed. The four-beat scene log and illustrated stage reveal observations; relevant comparisons are saved in an investigator's notebook. Evidence must support both a suspect and a method before a theory can solve the case. A wrong theory costs nothing, but guessing without the necessary comparisons will not close an act. The three authored mysteries involve a disappearing violin case, a moon that falls early, and a storm projected from an empty booth. Act progress, selected cues, notebook findings, and solved cases are saved locally.

summary.vi: Change stage cues, replay scenes, and prove three backstage mysteries.

description.vi: Giltlock Minute is a three-floor tactical stealth game contained entirely in the Firefox popup. Each move, wait, switch, or thrown decoy advances the guards by one beat. Guards see along straight, unobstructed corridors: three tiles in light, one tile after the power is cut. Dark shadow tiles conceal the player beyond a guard's adjacent tile. Later floors introduce a key-operated gate and a second patrol. A decoy can be thrown onto a nearby floor tile to draw guards away for two beats. Recover each floor's exhibit and return to its marked exit. Detection restarts only the current floor; there are no lives to lose. A clean extraction report records beats, detections, and decoy use. Progress is saved locally after each completed turn.

summary.vi: Plan turn-by-turn museum heists around patrols, shadows, power, and sound.

release_notes.en-US: Mock, modify, delay or block API requests from the page, with no backend changes.

description.en-US: Net Tinker does one thing: it lets you decide what an API answers while you work on the page that calls it — without touching your backend, without an account, and without anything leaving your machine. A rule says which requests to catch and what to do with them. Everything else — scenarios, importers, network simulation — is built on that one idea. WHAT A RULE CAN DO • Mock a response — your own status, headers and body. The request never reaches the network. • Change the real response — find and replace text, or overwrite one JSON field and leave the rest as the server sent it. • Modify a real request — headers, query parameters, body, or one JSON field of the body by its dotted path. • Redirect it, or rewrite part of the URL. A regex can reuse what it matched, so "send /api/v1/ to /api/v2/" is one rule, not one per endpoint. • Block it, or override the status code the real response came back with. • Add latency to any of the above: mocking an endpoint and slowing it down is one rule. • Fill one of your variables from the response, so the next requests can use what this one returned. • Print a line in the page's console when the rule fires — a breakpoint that doesn't stop anything. MAKE THE NETWORK MISBEHAVE ON PURPOSE • Random latency — a min-max range drawn fresh on every request. • A simulated timeout that fails the way a real one does: a TimeoutError for fetch, the timeout event for XMLHttpRequest. The branch your code was written for and could never reach. • Chaos, per rule — 20% a 500, 10% a timeout, the rest business as usual. • A call limit — the first N calls go through and everything after answers with the status you choose: what your interface does when something breaks AND stays broken. • Intermittent failure — one request in every N fails, never the first. The count belongs to the page: reloading starts it over and it is never written to disk. HIT EXACTLY THE REQUESTS YOU MEAN Match by URL or host — contains, exact, regex or wildcard — then narrow by HTTP method, request header, request body or the page making the call, and list URLs to leave alone. Paste a real URL into the test box and the form tells you whether it would be caught before you save. Pin a rule to a single tab when you don't want it anywhere else. Because GraphQL sends every operation to the same endpoint, matching on the body is what lets you mock one operation without touching the rest. SEE WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED Net Tinker adds a panel to the browser's DevTools with the requests of the page you are inspecting, and a log you can record and keep. • Every entry says what happened to THAT request: the status it really got, and whether a rule mocked it, delayed it, cut it off or let it through. • Repeated calls carry an xN badge, so a component that renders twice stands out. • A timing summary — how many, median and P95 — with the requests your own rules delayed counted apart. • Search inside the bodies, not only the URLs. • Compare two responses field by field, with volatile fields set aside and personal data masked. • GraphQL operation names are detected and shown. • One click turns any request into a rule, and "Mock" fills in the real status, headers and body. TAKE IT SOMEWHERE ELSE Copy a request or a rule as curl, as a fetch() call, as a Playwright or Cypress mock, as TypeScript types for the response, or as a bug report with request, response and a curl to reproduce it. Credentials are masked, and the snippet says what it hid. Sessions export as standard HAR. And the other way round: paste a curl command and Net Tinker builds the rule from it, method, headers and body included. SWITCH A WHOLE STATE AT ONCE A scenario is one API and several named variants — Login > Success / Invalid credentials / Backend down — with one variant live at a time. Rules of a variant that isn't live are never even looked at. You switch from the popup, per scenario, so two services can be in different states at once. Six ready-made scenarios spare you the empty list: HTTP errors, a REST collection in four states, sign-in, rate limiting, pagination and GraphQL — including errors returned with a 200. Every variant arrives with its rule written. KEEP TWO JOBS APART Rules, groups, scenarios, variables, environments, scope, bin and activity all live inside a project. Only the active project is shown and applied, so the client you are not working on today cannot answer one of your requests. REUSE THE SAME RULES EVERYWHERE Write {{variables}} into bodies, headers, redirect URLs and query parameters, and define environments — Local, Dev, Staging, Prod — that override only what changes. Switch from the popup and the same rules follow you from localhost to staging; one shortcut repoints a whole environment at another backend. A rule can fill a variable from a JSON field or a regex of a response, so {{JWT}} interpolates the token your login just issued. Captured values live in session memory only: never on disk, never in an export. DON'T TYPE WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE One Import button — or a file dropped anywhere on the options page — reads five kinds of file and tells them apart by their contents: • A Net Tinker export. • An OpenAPI or Swagger spec (3.0, 3.1, 2.0, JSON): every endpoint, method and response code becomes a rule with pattern, status and body written; several codes become a scenario. • A Postman collection (v2.0, v2.1): each saved example becomes a mock with its real status, headers and body. Environment exports bring their variables. • A HAR capture, turned into mocks — and it tells you how many carry credentials. • A ModHeader profile, with its headers, URL filter and exclusions. You untick the endpoints you don't want and they are never created. Everything arrives switched off, what could not be translated is listed with the reason, and importing the same spec again shows what changed since last time. STAY IN CONTROL • Choose where it works: everywhere, only on localhost, only on the domains you list, or everywhere except those. Outside that scope Net Tinker removes its own patches and doesn't touch the page, and the toolbar icon says so. • A permissions screen explains in plain words what the extension asks for and why. • When two rules match, the lower one wins, and you reorder them. A conflict check lists the active rules that silently cancel each other, and says which clashes are certain. • Filter by name, URL, description, tag, rule type, group, or scenario and variant — including rules in no group and rules outside every scenario. • Select what the filter shows and enable, disable, export or delete it in one go. • Group rules and switch a whole group on or off in one click. • Undo a delete: the last ten are kept, and one gesture is one entry. • Export and import to share a setup, optionally stripping credentials first. • A built-in help page explains each rule type and why a rule might not fire. • Light and dark themes: follow your system, or pick one. • Keyboard shortcuts: / to search, Alt+N for a new rule, Ctrl+S to save. Your rules run from the moment the page loads, whether or not DevTools is open. PRIVACY Everything is stored locally in your browser. No server, no account, no analytics, no tracking. Requests in the DevTools panel live in memory only; recording a tab keeps its 200 most recent requests, locally, only while you have it on. Net Tinker needs broad host access because it cannot know in advance which site you will write a rule for; that access only runs the rules you configure. It declares two permissions in total: storage, and that host access. No tabs, no scripting, no browsing data. Firefox lets you withdraw that access in the add-on's permissions; if you do, the popup tells you and offers to give it back, instead of leaving your rules silently doing nothing. NO LIMITS AND NO UPSELL Every rule type is free, with no cap on how many rules you create or keep active. That is worth saying plainly, because it is where comparable tools draw their paid line — the best-known one stops you at five rules, three of them active at a time. WHAT IT CANNOT DO It acts on the requests a page makes with fetch or XMLHttpRequest. Images, stylesheets, navigations and a site's own service worker are out of reach, and the DevTools panel says so. Specs and collections are read as JSON; YAML is recognised only to tell you to convert it. It needs Firefox 140 or later, and the DevTools panel is for Firefox on desktop. Useful for testing APIs, simulating backend errors, exercising the loading and error states of your frontend, or debugging an integration without depending on a real environment. Available in English and Spanish; the interface follows your browser unless you choose otherwise.
description.es-ES: Net Tinker hace una sola cosa: te deja decidir qué contesta una API mientras trabajas en la página que la llama — sin tocar tu backend, sin cuenta y sin que nada salga de tu equipo. Una regla dice qué peticiones atrapar y qué hacer con ellas. Todo lo demás —escenarios, importadores, simulación de red— se apoya en esa única idea. LO QUE PUEDE HACER UNA REGLA • Mockear la respuesta — tu estado, tus cabeceras y tu cuerpo. La petición no llega a salir a la red. • Cambiar la respuesta real — buscar y reemplazar texto, o sobrescribir un campo JSON y dejar el resto como lo mandó el servidor. • Modificar la petición real — cabeceras, parámetros de query, cuerpo, o un campo JSON del cuerpo por su ruta con puntos. • Redirigirla, o reescribir parte de la URL. Una regex puede reutilizar lo que capturó, así que «manda /api/v1/ a /api/v2/» es una regla, no una por endpoint. • Bloquearla, o sobrescribir el código de estado con el que volvió la respuesta real. • Añadir latencia a cualquiera de las anteriores: mockear un endpoint y además retrasarlo es una sola regla. • Rellenar una de tus variables con la respuesta, para que las peticiones siguientes usen lo que ésta trajo. • Escribir una línea en la consola de la página cuando la regla actúa — un punto de interrupción que no interrumpe nada. HACER QUE LA RED SE PORTE MAL A PROPÓSITO • Latencia aleatoria — un rango mínimo-máximo sorteado en cada petición. • Un timeout simulado que falla como uno de verdad: TimeoutError en fetch, el evento timeout en XMLHttpRequest. La rama para la que escribiste el código y a la que nunca llegabas. • Caos, por regla — 20% un 500, 10% un timeout, el resto normal. • Un límite de llamadas — las primeras N pasan y las siguientes contestan con el estado que elijas: qué hace tu interfaz cuando algo se rompe Y NO VUELVE. • Fallo intermitente — falla una de cada N, y nunca la primera. La cuenta es de la página: recargar la reinicia y no se escribe nunca en disco. ATRAPAR EXACTAMENTE LO QUE QUIERES Empareja por URL o host —contiene, exacta, regex o comodín— y afina por método HTTP, cabecera, cuerpo de la petición o la página que llama, y enumera las URL que hay que dejar en paz. Pega una URL real en el probador y el formulario te dice si la atraparía antes de guardar. Y clava una regla a una sola pestaña cuando no la quieras en ninguna otra. Como GraphQL manda todas las operaciones al mismo endpoint, emparejar por el cuerpo es lo que te deja mockear una operación sin tocar las demás. VER QUÉ HA PASADO DE VERDAD Net Tinker añade un panel a las DevTools del navegador con las peticiones de la página que inspeccionas, y un registro que puedes grabar y conservar. • Cada entrada dice qué le pasó A ESA petición: el estado que recibió de verdad, y si una regla la mockeó, la retrasó, la cortó o la dejó pasar. • Las llamadas repetidas llevan una insignia xN, así que un componente que se pinta dos veces salta a la vista. • Un resumen de tiempos —cuántas, mediana y P95— con las que retrasan tus propias reglas contadas aparte. • Buscar dentro de los cuerpos, no solo en las URL. • Comparar dos respuestas campo a campo, con los campos que cambian siempre apartados y los datos personales tapados. • Los nombres de operación de GraphQL se detectan y se enseñan. • Un clic convierte cualquier petición en regla, y «Mockear» rellena el estado, las cabeceras y el cuerpo reales. LLEVÁRTELO A OTRO SITIO Copia una petición o una regla como curl, como llamada fetch(), como mock de Playwright o de Cypress, como tipos de TypeScript de la respuesta, o como informe de defecto con petición, respuesta y un curl para reproducirlo. Las credenciales salen tapadas y el fragmento dice qué ha escondido. Las sesiones se exportan como HAR estándar. Y al revés: pega un comando curl y Net Tinker construye la regla, con su método, sus cabeceras y su cuerpo. CAMBIAR DE ESTADO ENTERO DE UNA VEZ Un escenario es una API y varias variantes con nombre —Login > Correcto / Credenciales inválidas / Backend caído— con una sola activa a la vez. Las reglas de una variante que no está activa el motor ni las mira. Cambias desde el popup, por escenario, así que dos servicios pueden estar en estados distintos a la vez. Seis escenarios listos te ahorran la lista vacía: errores HTTP, una colección REST en cuatro estados, inicio de sesión, límite de peticiones, paginación y GraphQL —incluidos los errores devueltos con un 200—. Cada variante llega con su regla escrita. MANTENER DOS TRABAJOS SEPARADOS Reglas, grupos, escenarios, variables, entornos, alcance, papelera y actividad viven dentro de un proyecto. Solo se enseña y se aplica el activo, así que el cliente en el que hoy no trabajas no puede contestar una de tus peticiones. REUTILIZAR LAS MISMAS REGLAS EN TODAS PARTES Escribe {{variables}} en cuerpos, cabeceras, URL de redirección y parámetros, y define entornos —Local, Dev, Staging, Prod— que solo sobrescriban lo que cambia. Cambias desde el popup y las mismas reglas te siguen de localhost a staging; y un atajo reapunta un entorno entero a otro backend. Una regla puede rellenar una variable con un campo JSON o una regex de una respuesta, así que {{JWT}} interpola el token que acaba de emitir tu login. Los valores capturados viven solo en memoria de sesión: ni en disco ni en un export. NO ESCRIBAS LO QUE YA TIENES Un solo botón de importar —o un fichero soltado en cualquier parte de la página de opciones— lee cinco tipos de fichero y los distingue por su contenido: • Un export de Net Tinker. • Una spec de OpenAPI o Swagger (3.0, 3.1, 2.0, JSON): cada endpoint, método y código de respuesta se convierte en una regla con patrón, estado y cuerpo escritos; varios códigos, en un escenario. • Una colección de Postman (v2.0, v2.1): cada ejemplo guardado se convierte en un mock con su estado, cabeceras y cuerpo reales. Un export de entorno trae sus variables. • Una captura HAR, convertida en mocks — y te dice cuántos llevan credenciales. • Un perfil de ModHeader, con sus cabeceras, su filtro de URL y sus exclusiones. Desmarcas los endpoints que no quieres y no llegan a crearse. Todo llega desactivado, lo que no se pudo traducir se enumera con el motivo, y reimportar la misma spec te dice qué ha cambiado desde la última vez. TENER EL CONTROL • Elige dónde actúa: en todas partes, solo en localhost, solo en los dominios que enumeres, o en todas menos ésos. Fuera de ese alcance Net Tinker se quita sus propios parches y no toca la página, y el icono de la barra lo dice. • Una pantalla de permisos explica con palabras normales qué pide la extensión y para qué. • Cuando dos reglas coinciden gana la de más abajo, y tú las reordenas. Un comprobador de conflictos enumera las reglas activas que se anulan sin avisar, y dice qué choques son seguros. • Filtra por nombre, URL, descripción, etiqueta, tipo, grupo, o escenario y variante — incluidas las reglas sin grupo y las que están fuera de todo escenario. • Selecciona lo que enseña el filtro y actívalo, desactívalo, expórtalo o bórralo de una vez. • Agrupa reglas y enciende o apaga un grupo entero de un clic. • Deshaz un borrado: se guardan los diez últimos, y un gesto es una entrada. • Exporta e importa para compartir un montaje, con la opción de quitar antes las credenciales. • Una página de ayuda explica cada tipo de regla y por qué una regla podría no dispararse. • Tema claro y oscuro: el de tu sistema, o el que elijas. • Atajos de teclado: / para buscar, Alt+N para una regla nueva, Ctrl+S para guardar. Tus reglas funcionan desde que carga la página, tengas o no las DevTools abiertas. PRIVACIDAD Todo se guarda localmente en tu navegador. Sin servidor, sin cuenta, sin analítica, sin seguimiento. Las peticiones del panel de DevTools viven solo en memoria; grabar una pestaña guarda sus 200 peticiones más recientes, en local, solo mientras lo tengas encendido. Net Tinker necesita acceso amplio a los sitios porque no puede saber de antemano para cuál vas a escribir una regla; ese acceso solo ejecuta las reglas que configuras tú. Declara dos permisos en total: almacenamiento y ese acceso. Ni pestañas, ni scripting, ni datos de navegación. Firefox te deja retirarle ese acceso en los permisos del complemento; si lo haces, el popup te lo dice y te ofrece devolvérselo, en vez de dejar tus reglas sin hacer nada en silencio. SIN LÍMITES Y SIN VENTA CRUZADA Todos los tipos de regla son gratis, sin tope de cuántas creas ni de cuántas tienes activas. Merece la pena decirlo claro, porque es justo donde las herramientas comparables ponen su línea de pago: la más conocida te para en cinco reglas, tres activas a la vez. LO QUE NO PUEDE HACER Actúa sobre las peticiones que la página hace con fetch o XMLHttpRequest. Las imágenes, las hojas de estilo, las navegaciones y el service worker del propio sitio quedan fuera, y el panel de DevTools lo dice. Las specs y colecciones se leen como JSON; un YAML se reconoce solo para decirte que lo conviertas. Necesita Firefox 140 o posterior, y el panel de DevTools es para Firefox de escritorio. Útil para probar APIs, simular errores de backend, ejercitar los estados de carga y de error de tu frontend, o depurar una integración sin depender de un entorno real. Disponible en español e inglés; la interfaz sigue a tu navegador salvo que elijas otra cosa.

name.es-ES: Net Tinker: mock y edición de respuestas de API

summary.en-US: Mock, redirect, delay or rewrite HTTP requests from the browser. No backend, no account, everything stays on your machine.
summary.es-ES: Mock de peticiones HTTP desde el navegador: simula, redirige, retrasa o reescribe. Sin backend, sin cuenta y sin salir de tu equipo.

description.en-US: A little less noise. More of the videos you came for. Shortless hides YouTube Shorts across the home feed, search results, channel pages, related videos and navigation. Hide Playables and optionally community posts, choose which surfaces to filter, or pause protection from the toolbar. OPTIONAL SLOP PATROL Patrol is off by default. After your consent, it sends visible video IDs, titles, channel names, description snippets and page language to Shortless's Cloudflare-hosted service. The metadata text is assessed by TypeSafe's Jev. Missing descriptions are requested from YouTube without account cookies. Patrol checks text metadata, not video or audio, and cannot prove AI authorship. Auto-hide is a separate choice and only hides strong low-value matches. Uncertain videos and service failures stay visible. Recent checks explain decisions; Always show lets you restore a video. No account or API key is required. LOCAL CONTROLS Settings, counters, recent checks, timing samples and Always show choices stay in this browser. There are no feedback uploads, advertising or analytics SDKs. Patrol is unavailable in private windows; local filters still work if you allow private access, without saving private activity. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance. Desktop Shortless is free. The separately sold iPhone/iPad app is not required and does not sync with this extension. Privacy and retention: https://shortless.app/privacy Support: https://shortless.app YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Shortless is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

caption.en-US: Choose local filters for Shorts, Playables and community posts. Illustrative local data.
Review recent Patrol checks and restore any video with Always show. Illustrative local data.
Patrol is optional, requires consent, and stays off in private windows.

summary.en-US: Hide YouTube Shorts and distractions. Optional Slop patrol checks video metadata for low-value content.

description.en-GB: Enhance ProgArchives Forum gives the ProgArchives.com forum a dark mode and a more readable style. Dark, light or automatic. The theme follows your system setting, or you choose: the Theme link in the forum's own menu bar goes round Auto, Dark and Light, and remembers your choice. The dark page never flashes white while it loads. Members' colours stay readable. Text a member coloured too dark to read on a dark background is lightened, keeping its hue, and put back when you switch to light. Easier to read in any theme. Slightly larger text with more line spacing, no more tall empty boxes around one-line posts, and images, long words and quotes kept inside the post. On your phone too. The forum's pages for phones get the same dark theme, with the switch beside the links at the top. No account, no permissions, no data collected: the extension runs only on the forum's pages and sends nothing anywhere. Enhance ProgArchives Forum is not made by or affiliated with ProgArchives.

summary.en-GB: A dark mode and a more readable style for the ProgArchives.com forum. Unofficial, not affiliated with ProgArchives.

summary.vi: Monitors active Firefox tabs and sends browsing activity to the local Parental Monitor agent.

summary.en-US: Translate text to Morse code and Morse code to text instantly. Fast, offline, simple, and lightweight utility.

description.tr: Bu eklenti kendi yaşadığım sorun çözümü olarak yüklenmiştir sizde her yeni youtube videosunda sesi kapanıyorsa arka planda bunu kullanarak çözebilirsiniz.

summary.tr: YouTube videosu her ne sebeple kapanırsa kapansın sesi anında geri açar.

description.en-US:
Playlist Length for YouTube™ shows how long a playlist takes to watch, right where you need it.
  • The total length of any playlist, under its title: every video, not just the first 100 the page lists
  • On a watch page: which video you are on, and the time left at the speed you are playing, updated as you watch
  • Finished videos are ticked off automatically (ads never count), and earlier ones in one click
  • "Plan schedule" opens the playlist on playlistduration.com with your progress and speed: choose minutes a day, see your finish date, and add the sessions to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook
  • Works in YouTube's dark and light themes, and from the toolbar button on any playlist
Private by design: it runs only on youtube.com, sends only the ID of the playlist you open to playlistduration.com, keeps your progress in your browser, and has no analytics and no ads. Numbers come from the YouTube Data API through playlistduration.com. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

caption.en-US: On a watch page: the total, which video you're on, and the time left at your playback speed
Under a playlist's title: total length, time left and how many you've watched
Plan schedule opens the playlist on playlistduration.com with your progress and speed: pick a daily pace, get a finish date
Counts down as you watch, in YouTube's light theme too
Every video counted, not just the first 100 the page lists

summary.en-US: Total length of any YouTube playlist, the time left at your playback speed, and a plan to finish it. Not affiliated with YouTube.

description.en-US:
Your sound, your volume.

Sound Master gives you a simple place to adjust the sound of the current website. Turn a quiet video up, soften a loud stream, or mute the whole tab in one click.

• Adjust supported audio and video from 0% to 600%.
• Choose quick presets: 50%, 100%, 200%, or 400%.
• Mute the whole tab, then return to your previous level.
• Reset to the original volume with one click.
• Switch to other playing or browser-muted tabs.
• See a clear notice when a website's own player is muted.
• Use the slider with your keyboard.

Designed to stay out of your way: warm ivory, dark ink, clear controls, and locally bundled typography. No account, ads, analytics, or audio uploads.

Firefox compatibility
Firefox 142 or newer is required. Volume adjustment works with accessible HTML audio/video players. Protected media, some cross-origin embeds, and custom Web Audio players may not support reduction or boosting. Whole-tab mute uses Firefox's built-in mute and works independently of the player. The popup explains detected limitations. Volume settings reset on navigation. Reload the page to completely detach an existing audio connection. High boosts can distort loud recordings.

Privacy
Audio is processed on your device. Sound Master reads open tab titles and addresses to display the current website and let you switch tabs; it does not upload or retain browsing history. Temporary per-tab volume and mute settings are stored only for the current browser session. It has no tracking, remote scripts, or external font requests.

The decorative waveform shows the selected volume; it is not a live audio meter.

caption.en-US: Simple volume control for the current tab, with quick presets and one-click mute.
Boost quiet audio up to 600%, then reset to the original volume.
A clear notice when the website player itself is muted.

summary.en-US: Simple tab volume control with up to 600% boost, one-click mute, and a beautifully clear interface.

description.en-US: Twitter Mark turns your X/Twitter bookmarks and likes into a fast, searchable archive stored in your browser. Features: - Read-only full and incremental sync for bookmarks and likes - Search by post content, link, author name, or username - Filter by media type, language, author, time, and custom tags - Organize saved items with account-specific tags and batch actions - Resume interrupted sync jobs and view synchronization history - Export and import your archive as JSON - Optional Pro features, including background automatic sync and higher limits Your synced X archive is stored locally in the browser. Twitter Mark never posts, likes, follows, sends messages, or removes bookmarks on your behalf. Syncing requires an active x.com login in the same browser. Twitter Mark is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp.
description.zh-CN: Twitter Mark 将你的 X/Twitter 书签和点赞只读同步到浏览器本地，整理成快速、可搜索的私人资料库。 主要功能： - 分别进行书签和点赞的全量或增量同步 - 按帖子正文、链接、作者名称或用户名搜索 - 按媒体类型、作者、语言、时间和自定义标签筛选 - 使用账号专属标签与批量操作整理内容 - 查看同步记录，并可暂停、恢复未完成的同步任务 - 支持 JSON 导入和导出，方便备份与迁移 - 可选 Pro 功能，包括更高的同步数量限制和后台自动同步 同步的 X 帖子内容和资料库数据保存在浏览器本地。Twitter Mark 不会替你发帖、点赞、关注、发送私信或取消书签。执行同步时，需要在同一浏览器中保持 x.com 登录状态。 Twitter Mark 是独立产品，与 X Corp. 不存在隶属、合作或认可关系。

caption.en-US: Browse your synced X/Twitter bookmarks in a clean, local-first library with content and author search, flexible filters, tags, and grid or list views.
Browse your synced X/Twitter bookmarks in a clean, local-first library with content and author search, flexible filters, tags, and grid or list views.
Browse your synced X/Twitter bookmarks in a clean, local-first library with content and author search, flexible filters, tags, and grid or list views.

summary.en-US: Sync, search, tag, and back up your X/Twitter bookmarks and likes in a private, local-first archive.
summary.zh-CN: 将 X/Twitter 书签和点赞只读同步到本地资料库，支持搜索、筛选、标签整理与 JSON 备份。

description.vi: The Latchwick Exchange is a short, self-contained hotel mystery inside the extension popup. Three guests each have an object that belongs to someone else: a brass compass, a pressed fern, and a violet ribbon. Visit the rooms, take the misplaced objects, read each guest's request, select the right item from your pockets, and speak to its owner. Return all three belongings, then claim a train ticket from the front desk. The room scenes, dialogue, pocket inventory, and progress update as you play. There is no timer and no irreversible mistake: wrong gifts are rejected without losing the item. Room, inventory, returned belongings, and completion are saved locally.

summary.vi: Explore a small hotel and return three misplaced belongings.

description.vi: Tetherwake is a short side-scrolling kite crossing played in the Firefox popup. Guide a traveler over a sequence of canyon gaps. Pale wind columns lift the kite, while still air lets it glide and descend. Collect three copper map fragments along the ledges and reach the tower at the far right to complete the route. Marked ledges act as checkpoints: falling returns you to the latest one without removing collected fragments. The player can use A/D or left/right arrows to move and hold Space to lift. For mouse play, the left/right buttons move the traveler and the LIFT button toggles the kite on or off. The game saves locally at checkpoints, fragments, periodic intervals, and when the popup is hidden.

summary.vi: Ride canyon updrafts, gather a torn map, and reach the tower.

description.vi: Siltstamp is a compact postal adventure played entirely in the extension popup. Read a hand-drawn island chart, move across stone shores and temporary sand causeways, and deliver a letter to each of three islanders. Low tide opens the sand for eight turns; high tide closes it for four. If the water catches you on sand, you return to your last stone tile with no lost life or letter. Once all three letters are delivered, return to the western dock to finish the voyage. Use arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to wait, and E to deliver; the same actions have visible popup buttons. The current turn, position, delivered letters, and ending are saved locally so the voyage can be resumed.

summary.vi: Carry three letters across a shifting low-tide island map.

description.en-US:
StudyGuard helps you stay focused by blocking distracting music and entertainment websites during timed study sessions.
  • Start focused study sessions with customizable durations.
  • Block supported music and entertainment websites while a session is active.
  • Automatically pause media playback when possible.
  • Display a study lock screen while blocked sites are open.
  • Persistent countdown timer that continues even when the extension popup is closed.
  • Local study-session statistics.
  • Emergency session termination with deliberate confirmation.
Currently supported:
  • Spotify
  • YouTube
  • YouTube Music
  • Amazon Music
  • SoundCloud
StudyGuard does not require an account or external server. Study sessions and settings are stored locally in the browser. The extension does not transmit user browsing data or study-session information to an external server.

summary.en-US: Block music and entertainment websites during timed study sessions to help you stay focused.

description.en-GB: IMPORTANT: Requires the TabFlick app for macOS — install and open it first. This extension alone does nothing. DESCRIPTION: TabFlick is an Alt-Tab-style switcher for your browser tabs. Hold ⌃Tab and your tabs appear as live previews, ordered by how recently you used them. Keep tapping Tab to move through them, release to switch. Press ⌥Tab from any app on your Mac to see every window of every connected browser in one list and switch to any tab directly. Get the Mac app: https://e.gluhotorenko.com/tab-flick/#get

summary.en-GB: Companion for the TabFlick macOS app — install it first, then hold ⌃Tab for a switcher with live previews of your tabs.

description.en-US: Jagrik AI helps Indian consumers file complaints on the e-Jagriti portal faster and with fewer mistakes. Prepare your case in the Jagrik AI web app at https://jagrik.com. An AI assistant asks you about your complaint and drafts the documents you need under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. When you open the e-Jagriti filing form, this extension fills in the fields for you from that case data. WHAT IT DOES • Fills the e-Jagriti complaint form using the case you prepared on Jagrik AI • Saves you from retyping names, addresses, dates, amounts and case details • Lets you review every field before you submit. Nothing is submitted on your behalf HOW TO USE 1. Sign in at https://jagrik.com and complete your case with the AI assistant 2. Open the complaint filing form on e-Jagriti 3. Click the Jagrik AI extension icon and choose your case to fill the form 4. Check the details and submit the form yourself on e-Jagriti PRIVACY The extension runs only on the e-Jagriti website. It reads case data only from your own Jagrik AI account. It does not sell your data or share it with third parties, and it does not track your browsing. Privacy policy: https://jagrik.com/privacy DISCLAIMER Jagrik AI is built by Lev-Tech. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Government of India, the Department of Consumer Affairs, or the e-Jagriti portal. Jagrik AI does not provide legal advice. Please verify all information before you file.

summary.en-US: Auto-fills e-Jagriti consumer complaint forms using your Jagrik AI case data.

description.ru:
EN: This add‑on adds the sounds of the character Tenna from Deltarune. When you press letters or numbers on the keyboard, the sound of Tenna speaking is played. When you press Enter or Backspace, other sounds from Chapter 3 of Deltarune are played. Enjoy!
РУ: Это дополнение добавляет звуки, издаваемые персонажем Тенной из Deltarune. При нажатии букв или цифр на клавиатуре воспроизводится звук, издаваемый Тенной. При нажатии Enter или пробела назад воспроизводятся другие звуки из главы 3 Deltarune. Наслаждайтесь!

description.en-US:
MossDL Capture sends download links and media addresses from Firefox to the MossDL download manager for Windows. It requires the MossDL desktop application with its browser connection enabled.

Send links from the right-click menu, find file links on a page, or send media addresses to the desktop app. Optional stream detection finds supported media addresses in the current tab; you choose which ones to send.

Automatic download capture starts disabled. When enabled, the extension stops a browser download only after MossDL acknowledges the handoff. If the desktop connection fails, the browser download is left untouched.

Optional site-session sharing asks before sending cookies to your local MossDL installation. Support varies by website; the extension does not guarantee access to protected streams or every download source.

Requires Firefox 142 or later on Windows. This extension is not a standalone downloader.

summary.en-US: Send download links and media to the MossDL desktop app. Requires MossDL for Windows.

description.vi: Undo Trail is a manual, reversible field record for a repair or experiment. Start with a named trail and a description of the last working condition. Each step records one change, the observed result, and a concrete instruction for reversing it. After confirming that a step worked, mark it as the known-good checkpoint. The Reverse Route then lists only the steps after that checkpoint in reverse order, so the newest change is undone first. Steps can be edited, and the last step can be removed after an in-popup confirmation. A finished trail can be archived locally, viewed, restored as the current trail, or deleted after confirmation. The extension does not run commands, inspect the computer, restore a system, read webpages, or automate a repair. It is a record to support the user's own judgment. Trails and their history are stored only in localStorage in the Firefox profile; there is no account, analytics, sync, or network traffic.

summary.vi: Keep a reversible record of changes during a repair or experiment.

description.vi: Object Address is a small local index for physical things that are easy to misplace. Record an object name and a home path made from an area or room, a container, and an exact spot; at least one location field is required. Search by any part of the object's name, location, or the person who has it. The list can be filtered to all objects, objects at home, or objects on loan. An object on loan retains its home address while showing who currently has it; mark it returned to clear that temporary status. You can edit or move an address and remove an entry after an in-popup confirmation. The extension does not locate objects automatically, use the camera, scan barcodes, read webpages, contact borrowers, send reminders, or sync to another device. All entries are user-supplied and kept in localStorage in the Firefox profile. It works offline and needs no account.

summary.vi: Give rarely used objects a precise, searchable place to live.

description.vi: Crossing Hours is a compact availability board for one day in one time zone. Add two to five people and up to four free intervals for each person. The popup draws each person's free hours on a 24-hour rail and highlights the exact intersection on a separate Together rail. It identifies the longest common window, reports its duration, and counts the shared windows. Intervals are calculated to the minute; adjacent or overlapping intervals belonging to one person are combined before the group intersection is found. Incomplete or backward intervals are explained rather than treated as available time. The board is intentionally manual: it does not read calendars, browser tabs, contacts, meeting invites, or other websites, and it does not send invitations or notifications. The roster and entered intervals remain in localStorage in the Firefox profile so the board is available when the popup reopens. No account or internet connection is required. Overnight windows and different time zones are outside this version's scope.

summary.vi: Find a shared time window from availability entered by hand.

description.vi: Return Point is a small, private handoff form for interrupted work. Before leaving, write the name of the work, the exact point where you stopped, the first physical action to take on return, and an optional dead end to avoid repeating. The pinned slip puts that next action first when you open the Firefox toolbar popup again. Edit the current slip if plans change, or mark it resumed to move it into a scrollable history of past handoffs. The extension is deliberately not a task manager: it keeps one active return point in front of you and does not send reminders, schedule tasks, or read browser tabs. Notes are stored locally in this Firefox profile and remain until you remove the extension's local data or the profile. The interface is entirely in English, works offline, and requires no account.

summary.vi: Leave yourself a precise handoff before you stop working.

description.vi: Clearance Paper is a focused measuring aid for flat, axis-aligned fit questions. Enter an item's width and height, an opening's width and height, and any clearance required on each side. A scaled drawing shows the item against the opening, while the result reports width and height spare or over. Switch between upright and a 90-degree turn; both orientation outcomes stay visible. Change units among millimetres, centimetres, and inches without changing the underlying physical measurements. The current measurements and orientation are stored locally so they return when the popup is reopened. The extension explicitly does not model depth, handles, hinges, diagonal tilting, or the path through a three-dimensional doorway, and it must not be used as a safety or engineering certification. It reads no webpages, works offline, requires no account, and is entirely in English.

summary.vi: Check whether a rectangular item fits within a measured 2D opening.

description.vi: Almost Certain is a personal forecast ledger, not a prediction service. Write a concrete yes-or-no statement, select confidence from 5% to 95%, and choose a date on which to check it. When the outcome is known, resolve the entry as Yes or No. The ledger separates open and resolved forecasts and shows the average squared probability error after at least one outcome; lower is better. You can edit a forecast, reopen a mistakenly resolved outcome, or remove an entry after confirmation. There are no notifications, background checks, accounts, leaderboards, webpage analysis, analytics, or network requests. All entries and outcomes remain on this device in the Firefox profile unless removed or browser extension data is cleared. The interface is entirely in English and works offline.

summary.vi: Record a yes-or-no prediction, then compare confidence with reality.

description.en-GB: UIU UCAM Course Evaluation Automator is a modern, lightweight, and secure browser extension designed specifically for United International University (UIU) students. It automates the tedious end-of-trimester course evaluation process on the official UIU UCAM portal (https://ucam.uiu.ac.bd/) in seconds. ⚡ KEY FEATURES: • One-Click Course Evaluation: Automatically evaluates all registered courses with a single click. • Customizable Target Grade: Choose your desired expected grade (A, A-, B+, etc.) across all evaluation forms. • Consistent Rating System: Answers all evaluation questions with positive ratings automatically. • Real-Time Course Progress Tracker: Live progress bar and counter (Course X of Y) in both the extension popup and on-page floating badge. • Smart ASP.NET AJAX Error Detection: Instantly detects invalid passwords, account status issues, or server errors, halting automation safely. • Interactive Bottom-Right Toast Alerts: Informs you of errors or completion without disruptive browser alerts. • Completion Celebration Engine: Features celebration cannons and a completion summary dialog upon finishing all course evaluations. • Live Activity Logs: Transparent real-time log box displaying every automated action step-by-step. 🔒 PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST: • 100% Client-Side: All processing occurs entirely inside your local browser. • Zero Data Collection: The extension does NOT collect, track, transmit, or sell any personal data or browsing history. • Safe Password Handling: Passwords used during the session are purged from memory immediately after authentication. • Local Storage Only: If "Save Login Info" is enabled, credentials remain encrypted inside local browser storage on your device only. • Scoped Exclusively to UCAM: The extension operates ONLY on https://ucam.uiu.ac.bd/* and has zero access to any other website. 📖 HOW TO USE: 1. Open the extension popup from your Firefox toolbar. 2. Enter your UIU Student ID and Password. 3. Select your Expected Grade. 4. Click "✨ Start Automation". 5. Sit back and watch your courses get evaluated with live progress tracking! ⚠ DISCLAIMER: This is an independent open-source tool built by Irfan Haider Abir (Student ID: 0112230474) to assist UIU students. It is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by United International University (UIU). All university trademarks and portal rights belong to UIU.

summary.en-GB: Automates course evaluations on UIU UCAM with smart grading, real-time progress tracking, and secure local authentication.

summary.de: Import welcome guides into Sittify and export them to PDF.

description.en-US:
Adds a Fold / Unfold button to every code block in AI chat interfaces, so long snippets stop pushing the conversation off the screen. Code blocks are expanded by default — one click collapses them.
  • chat.qwen.ai (also qwen.ai, tongyi.aliyun.com)
  • chat.deepseek.com
Adding a new site is a one-object change to src/sites.ts. See Adding a site below.
  • A pill-shaped ▾ Fold button appears in each code block's header, next to Copy / Download.
  • Clicking it hides the code body and replaces it with a dimmed ▸ Click to unfold line.
  • Clicking that line — or the button again — expands the block.
  • On Qwen, expanding dispatches a resize event so the Monaco editor redraws its virtual viewport correctly.

description.en-US:
STU Media Downloader — High-Performance Multi-Protocol Media & Download Manager

STU Media Downloader is a high-speed, cross-platform media downloader that combines a powerful Python Flask backend with a modern browser extension frontend. Designed for maximum download speeds, seamless stream detection, and multi-protocol versatility.

🌟 Key Capabilities & Features:

⚡ Multi-Connection Acceleration (3×–5× Faster):
Powered by aria2c with up to 16 parallel connections per file, maximizing your network bandwidth for rapid downloads.

🎬 Smart Video Player Detection:
Automatically detects HTML5 video players on any website and injects a 1-click ⚡ Download overlay badge directly onto the video player.

📡 HLS / M3U8 Stream Interception:
Intercepts .m3u8 playlists and .ts video segments (including CDN-gated streams). Downloads HLS streams with multi-threaded --concurrent-fragments 16 acceleration.

🧲 Torrent & FTP Engine:
Direct multi-connection downloading for:
• BitTorrent Magnet Links (magnet:?xt=...)
• .torrent metainfo file URLs & local file uploads
• FTP & SFTP server downloads (ftp://, sftp://)
• Direct HTTP / HTTPS file links

⚡ Real-Time Live Progress (SSE):
Live Server-Sent Events stream speed, file size (downloaded / total), percentage, and estimated time remaining (ETA) inside the Queue tab.

📜 Persistent Download History:
Built-in SQLite database history with instant search, pagination, and multi-category filters (Video, Audio, Torrent, FTP, Direct, Completed, Failed, Cancelled).

📂 Native OS Folder Picker & File Explorer:
One-click native OS folder selection and instant folder opening in File Explorer / Finder / File Manager.

⚙ Settings Customization:
Configure simultaneous download limits, connection threads, default formats (MP4/MKV/MP3/WebM), quality options (Best, 1080p, 720p), and output paths.

🛡 Privacy-First & Local Processing:
100% local processing. Does not collect, track, or share any personal user data (data_collection_permissions: none).

summary.en-US: STU Media Downloader — High-speed media, HLS stream, Torrent & FTP downloader with aria2c multi-connection acceleration, live progress, and persistent history.

description.zh-CN:
Threads 脆备份是一款用于备份自己 Threads 个人主页内容的本地归档工具。

使用前请先登录 Threads，并打开你自己的个人主页。插件支持安全手动滚动和可选自动扫描，可持续保存页面中已经加载的帖子内容，并自动去重。

主要功能包括：备份个人主页帖子，保存页面可取得的图片、视频和媒体信息，支持 HTML、PDF、JSON 导出和完整离线归档；对于内容较多的账号，还支持分页读取、自动去重、分块导出和中断后继续补抓。

推荐优先使用“安全备份（手动滚动）”：用户正常浏览并向下滚动，插件只保存页面已经显示的帖子。自动扫描属于可选模式，会主动滚动页面并限速；遇到验证码、平台限制或异常提示时应停止使用。

完整备份默认保存在用户自己的浏览器和主动导出的本地文件中。插件不要求用户向开发者提供 Threads 密码，不读取私信，也不会后台上传完整备份数据。

除核心 Threads 本地备份功能外，插件提供一个可关闭、完全可选的账号商业价值测试延伸入口“顺便测个报价”。该入口不是完成备份所必需，只有用户主动点击后才会打开独立网页，并且不会自动发送 Threads 用户名、粉丝数、帖子、图片、视频或备份文件。

导出完成后还会出现“测测广告报价”和“社媒坟场”两个完全可选的下一步，用户可以直接关闭，不影响已经完成的备份和导出。

Threads、Meta 及相关标志归其各自权利人所有。本扩展为独立第三方工具，与 Meta / Threads 无官方隶属、赞助或授权关系。

description.en-US:
REveal shows extra information about a property listing that the page already sends to your browser but doesn't put on screen. No more "Contact Agent" or "Price Withheld" where a price should be. When you open a listing on domain.com.au, a small panel appears in the corner with:
  • The price recorded in the page data, even when the listing says "Contact Agent" or "Price Withheld". For sold listings it also shows the recorded sale price, the sale date and where the price came from.
  • Days on market and the first-listed and last-updated dates
  • Price history from your own visits. It saves a dated note whenever a listing's price or status changes between visits, so you can see what has moved.
  • Extra listing details, such as whether a Statement of Information exists, the number of floor plans, land size and energy rating
  • Agency and agent details, including agent phone numbers
  • Suburb figures such as median price, median rent and auction clearance
Close the panel with the ✕ and it stays closed for that page. Collapse it with the ▾ when you just want it out of the way. Please read: The price shown is whatever number the listing's page data contains. Agents enter it themselves, so it may be out of date, approximate, or different from what they'll accept. Treat it as a hint, never as a guarantee. Price history only covers listings you have opened while the extension was installed. It can't show changes from before your first visit. If the site changes, the panel may show less or nothing until the extension is updated. Privacy: REveal collects no data. Everything it reads comes from the page you're viewing, and your price history is saved only in your browser's local extension storage. Nothing is sent to me or to anyone else, and uninstalling the extension deletes the history. The only network request it can make is reloading the listing page you're already viewing, after you move between listings on the site. Permissions: Access to domain.com.au pages, so it can read the listing you're viewing Storage, to keep your price history on your own device Support If this tool helped you find a home, there's an optional tip button at the bottom of the panel. It's just a link to a Buy Me a Coffee page. REveal is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to domain.com.au or any other property website.

description.en-US:
Work out what you may legally add to an overdue B2B invoice: statutory interest at the locked half-year rate, plus the automatic fixed compensation almost every invoice forgets. Click Add to Firefox on this page. Nothing to unzip, no developer mode - the free version runs right away.
  • Half-year rate lock — Applies the reference rate in force on 31 December or 30 June before the invoice fell late, which is the rate the statute points at - not the rate in force today.
  • Fixed compensation tier — Adds the automatic recovery sum for the size of the debt: 40, 70 or 100 pounds in the UK, 40 euro in the euro area. It is owed even if the contract says nothing.
  • German nine-point margin — Uses the nine percentage points that section 288(2) BGB gives on German B2B debts, instead of the eight-point EU minimum that general-purpose calculators apply everywhere.
  • Shortfall against the shortcut — Shows in money what the invoice loses if the fixed sum is left off and the flat eight-point margin is used - the two mistakes that make up almost every under-billed claim.
  • Claim ledger export — With a licence key: downloads the worked figures as a .csv row you can keep, hand to your accountant, or attach to a letter before action.

description.en-US:
Section 530, the VCSP, or the audit - what each one actually costs you Click Add to Firefox on this page. Nothing to unzip, no developer mode - the free version runs right away.
  • Section 530 safe harbour check — Tests all three statutory conditions - reporting consistency, substantive consistency, reasonable basis - and names the exact prong you fail, using the 25% significant-segment and 10-year long-standing definitions the IRS set in Rev. Proc. 2025-10, its first update to Section 530 in 40 years.
  • VCSP settlement amount — Computes the cheque you would write on Form 8952: 10% of the section 3509(a) liability on the most recent tax year, with the social security wage base applied per worker, and tells you whether the 1099 and open-examination gates leave the programme open to you at all.
  • Do-nothing audit exposure — Prices the other choice across the open years at section 3509(a) or 3509(b) rates plus FUTA, so the settlement figure has something to stand next to.
  • Form 8952 120-day deadline — Works back 120 days from the date you want the workers to become employees, says whether that filing date has already gone, and gives the earliest start date still reachable if you file today.
